recurring.title: Recurring Payments
recurring.description: Set up recurring stealth payments on Stellar. Reminder mode fires a browser notification when a payment is due; pre-sign mode signs all future transactions upfront for automatic submission.
recurring.modeDesc_reminder: Browser notification fires at the scheduled time. You open the app and send manually.
recurring.modeDesc_presign: You sign all future transactions now. The app submits them automatically at each scheduled time. Requires the tab to be open.
recurring.label: Label
presignWarningItems: Stellar transactions include a sequence number tied to your account at signing time. Any operation that bumps the sequence (another send, account merge) will invalidate pending pre-signed transactions.
Submitted transactions cannot be recalled once broadcast to Horizon.
Time-bound drift: if your system clock is off, transactions may be submitted too early or expire.
Keep the tab open or the scheduler will not run. No service worker is used for submission.
recurring.presignWarningAck: I understand the risks and want to pre-sign transactions
recurring.emptyBody: Add one above and it will appear here. Payments persist across reloads.
recurring.noSlots: No pre-signed slots. Click 'Sign more' to sign future transactions.
recurring.notifBannerPrompt: Allow browser notifications so reminders fire even when this tab is in the background.
recurring.notifBannerDenied: Notification permission was denied. Enable it in browser settings to receive reminders.
recurring.errorAmount: Amount must be greater than zero.
recurring.errorPresignAck: You must acknowledge the pre-sign risks before continuing.
recurring.errorEndDate: End date is not a valid date.
recurring.errorNoFutureTimes: No future occurrences to sign. Check your interval and end date.
recurring.errorPresignFailed: Pre-signing failed. Check your wallet and try again.
